description: Natural Gas Underground Storage - North American Cooperation on Energy Information is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Natural Resources Canada | Ressources naturelles Canada. Sub-surface facilities used for storing natural gas. The facilities are usually hollowed-out salt domes, geological reservoirs (depleted oil or gas field) or water bearing sands (called aquifers) topped by an impermeable cap rock. Coverage: Canada. The portal files it under the publisher Natural Resources Canada | Ressources naturelles Canada. Its tags are Canada, États-Unis, Mexique, Énergie, Gaz naturel. It offers 8 resource(s) in ESRI REST, SHP, WMS, XLS. The portal shows 2021-05-19 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Canada (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support gas network and biomethane studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
